verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms doola serves an llms.txt at docs.doola.com that indexes its Partner API docs, with entries covering EIN workflows and formation error handling. Doc pages are also served as .md files, and an agent-oriented skill.md documents its Formation MCP server, so an agent can be pointed directly at machine-friendly docs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent actually consuming these docs effectively, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404) to complement the llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
